skill.name: improving-components
skill.description: Applies structured improvements to Claude Code components from quality analysis results. It improves descriptions, tool permissions, documentation, examples, and marketplace readiness while preserving behavior.
skill.summary: Improve Claude Code components while preserving their purpose and security boundaries.
skill.author: C0ntr0lledCha0s

security_audit.summary: All static command-execution hits appear to be false positives caused by Markdown fences, YAML examples, and documentation templates. The skill grants only Read and Edit permissions, and I found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable payload in SKILL.md. The referenced helper script is not present in the analyzed package, so that documentation should be clarified.

remediation.suggestion: Use plain text fences for non-executable workflow examples, or label them as examples that should not be run directly.

remediation.issue: The skill references scripts/apply-improvements.py, but only SKILL.md was present in the analyzed package.
remediation.suggestion: Include the referenced script with the package or remove the Scripts Available section to avoid misleading users.

remediation.issue: Bash examples appear in documentation even though the skill does not grant Bash.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the least-privilege frontmatter and clarify that shell commands require separate user approval outside this skill.

content.value_statement: Component updates can leave vague descriptions, broad tool permissions, and weak examples. This skill applies structured improvements that preserve behavior while improving clarity, security, and usability.
actual_capabilities: Improves skill, agent, command, and hook descriptions with clearer trigger language.
Reviews allowed tool lists and suggests least-privilege alternatives.
Applies documentation and example templates to component Markdown files.
Plans improvements from quality analysis priorities.
Uses Read and Edit permissions to inspect and update component files.
Provides before-and-after summaries with quality impact notes.
limitations: Requires a target component or prior quality analysis results.
Does not run validators or shell commands because Bash is not allowed.
Does not include the referenced helper script in this package.
Needs user review for changes that could alter component behavior.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Skill for Marketplace
use_cases.description: Improve a skill description, examples, and safety notes before submission.

use_cases.title: Reduce Tool Permissions
use_cases.description: Review a component for excessive tools and replace them with narrower permissions.

use_cases.title: Upgrade Existing Components
use_cases.description: Apply current documentation and trigger standards to older Claude Code components.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Description
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Claude Code component and improve its description. Preserve behavior and explain the main before-and-after difference.

prompt_templates.title: Tighten Permissions
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this component tool list. Recommend the minimum required tools and explain why each removed tool is unnecessary.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Quality Findings
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these quality analysis findings to update the component. Apply critical fixes first, then improve documentation and examples.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Marketplace Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this component for marketplace publication. Strengthen triggers, permissions, documentation, examples, and final validation notes.

output_examples.input: A skill has a vague description and a broad tool list.
output_examples.output: The result is a clearer description, a reduced tool list, and a short reason for each permission change.

output_examples.input: A quality report lists missing examples and weak activation triggers.
output_examples.output: The result adds concrete trigger phrases, usage examples, and a summary of remaining recommendations.

output_examples.input: An older component needs marketplace preparation.
output_examples.output: The result preserves the component purpose while improving structure, safety notes, and user-facing documentation.

best_practices: Start from a quality analysis report so every edit has evidence.
Preserve the component purpose and user-facing behavior during edits.
Review tool permissions first because security issues have highest priority.
anti_patterns: Do not add broad tools only to make examples easier.
Do not rewrite a component purpose while improving its wording.
Do not apply many unrelated changes without a clear before-and-after summary.

faq.question: What components can this skill improve?
faq.answer: It covers Claude Code skills, agents, commands, and hooks described in Markdown component files.

faq.question: Does it create new components?
faq.answer: It focuses on improving existing components. A separate builder workflow is better for new component creation.

faq.question: Can it reduce security risk?
faq.answer: Yes. It prioritizes least-privilege tool permissions and safer documentation patterns.

faq.question: Does it run shell commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill frontmatter allows Read and Edit only, so validation commands need separate user approval.

faq.question: Does it need another skill first?
faq.answer: It works best after a quality analysis, but it can also review a clearly provided component directly.

faq.question: What output should users expect?
faq.answer: Users should expect edited component text, a change summary, and remaining recommendations.
